# Test Fixtures

`synthetic_wt` is a fake War Thunder-like folder for scanner validation. It contains only text placeholders with Dagor-style names, so it is safe to commit and must not be treated as real game data.

The app should accept it as a plausible install marker set because it has:

- `aces.exe`
- `content/`
- `content/base/res/`
- `.vromfs.bin`, `.grp`, `.dxp.bin`, `.blk`, `riDesc.bin`, and `dynModelDesc.bin` placeholder files
